name: MCB 5077
title: Practicum in NMR Spectroscopy
description: Hands-on training in heteronuclear NMR spectroscopy of biomolecules. Topics include protein folding, protein dynamics, binding of ligands to proteins, and protein structure determination.
requirement_description: Instructor consent required. Recommended Preparation: MCB 5076 or MCB 2000 or MCB 3010.
